prompt: Write a short paragraph about why sparse attention helps long-context language models. Keep it around eighty words. No bullet points.
content: Standard attention mechanisms scale quadratically with sequence length, making long-context processing computationally prohibitive. Sparse attention addresses this bottleneck by restricting interactions to only the most relevant tokens, thereby reducing complexity from quadratic to linear or near-linear. This efficiency allows models to handle significantly longer inputs without exhausting memory or processing power. By focusing computational resources on critical dependencies rather than every possible pair, sparse attention enables scalable, high-performance long-context understanding while maintaining essential contextual coherence and reducing inference latency.
